label: Open Heritage 3D — terrestrial LiDAR and photogrammetry of heritage sites, 441 point clouds from 243 projects (Potree, via /stream)
source: https://openheritage3d.org/data — every project's Potree config.js (https://pointcloud.ucsd.edu/archive_temp/oh3d_store/oh3d-vis/datasets/<doi>/potree/config.js) names its point clouds; title, country and licence from https://openheritage3d.org/api/project_*.php; coordinates from the project page's map. Rebuilt by scripts/openheritage3d-manifest.mjs.
note: Licences are per dataset (CC BY or CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, chosen by the contributor): carried on each entry. The scans are in local frames; each is placed at its project's map coordinates (lon/lat), so a cloud sits at the site, not necessarily aligned to the imagery.
